answer_1.quote: We propose the controllable recipe editing task to assist an under-served population of home cooks by editing recipes to satisfy their dietary constraints
answer_1.outputs: edited recipes with modified ingredients and instructions

answer_2.quote: We first compare SHARE to baseline models via quantitative experiments on RecipePairs.

answer_4.quote: We recruited evaluators using the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform, restricting to native English speakers with a 99% acceptance rate.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked the question "Does this recipe use ingredients that violate the dietary constraint?" and further asked to provide free-form textual feedback if any.
